For hotel conversions, owners typically consider **soft brands or collection brands that preserve the property’s identity while adding global distribution, loyalty, sales and revenue-management capabilities**.

## Most commonly considered global platforms

| Hotel company | Collection / soft-brand options | Typical positioning |
|---|---|---|
| **Marriott International** | **The Luxury Collection**, **Autograph Collection**, **Tribute Portfolio**; also **Design Hotels** for design-led independents | Luxury through upper-upscale |
| **Hilton** | **LXR Hotels & Resorts**, **Curio Collection by Hilton**, **Tapestry Collection by Hilton**, and newer **Outset Collection by Hilton** | Luxury through upscale |
| **Hyatt** | **The Unbound Collection by Hyatt**, **JdV by Hyatt**, **Destination by Hyatt**; newer **Unscripted by Hyatt** | Luxury/upper-upscale, boutique and resort through upscale |
| **IHG Hotels & Resorts** | **Vignette Collection** and newer **Noted Collection** | Luxury and premium/upper-upscale |
| **Accor** | **Emblems Collection**, **MGallery Collection**, **Handwritten Collection** | Luxury through midscale/upscale boutique |
| **Wyndham Hotels & Resorts** | **Registry Collection Hotels**, **Trademark Collection by Wyndham**, and **Dolce Hotels and Resorts** | Luxury, upper-midscale/upscale, resorts and conference hotels |
| **Radisson Hotel Group** | **Radisson Individuals**, sometimes **Radisson Collection** for higher-end distinctive assets | Primarily upscale through luxury |
| **Choice Hotels** | **Ascend Collection** | Upscale independent, historic, boutique and resort hotels |
| **BWH Hotels / WorldHotels** | **BW Premier Collection**, **BW Signature Collection**; **WorldHotels Luxury, Elite, Distinctive and Crafted** | Midscale through luxury |

Marriott formally identifies Luxury Collection, Autograph Collection and Tribute Portfolio as its independent-hotel collection brands. ([hotel-development.marriott.com](https://www.hotel-development.marriott.com/brands/premium-brands?utm_source=openai)) Hilton’s collection portfolio now includes LXR, Curio, Tapestry and Outset. ([stories.hilton.com](https://stories.hilton.com/whats-new-at-hilton-in-2026?utm_source=openai)) Hyatt markets Unbound, Destination and JdV as independent collections, while Unscripted is its newer, conversion-oriented upscale collection. ([hyatt.com](https://www.hyatt.com/en-US/brands/hyatt-independent-collections?utm_source=openai))

IHG’s established soft-brand offering is Vignette Collection; **Noted Collection**, launched on **February 17, 2026**, is a new premium collection primarily targeting upscale-to-upper-upscale conversions and is still at an early rollout stage. ([development.ihg.com](https://development.ihg.com/hotel-brands/vignette-collection?utm_source=openai)) Accor positions Emblems, MGallery and Handwritten as collection brands across luxury, upper-upscale and more accessible segments. ([group.accor.com](https://group.accor.com/en/news-stories/collection-brands-handwritten-emblems-mgallery?utm_source=openai))

Wyndham explicitly describes Registry, Trademark and Dolce as soft-brand conversion options. ([development.wyndhamhotels.com](https://development.wyndhamhotels.com/brand/registry-collection-hotels/?utm_source=openai)) Radisson Individuals, Choice’s Ascend Collection and the BWH/WorldHotels collections are also established independence-preserving alternatives. ([radissonhotels.com](https://www.radissonhotels.com/en-us/corporate/media/press-releases/Radisson-Individuals-brand-celebrates-100th-property-milestone-and-now-offers-even-more-opportunities-for-guests-and-owners?utm_source=openai))

## Practical shortlist by asset type

- **Luxury landmark or destination resort:** Luxury Collection, LXR, Vignette Collection, Emblems Collection, Unbound Collection, Registry Collection or WorldHotels Luxury.
- **Upper-upscale independent/boutique:** Autograph Collection, Curio Collection, MGallery, JdV, Tribute Portfolio, Noted Collection or WorldHotels Elite/Crafted.
- **Upscale conversion with moderate brand overlay:** Tapestry Collection, Outset Collection, Handwritten Collection, Radisson Individuals, Ascend Collection, Trademark Collection, BW Premier Collection or Unscripted by Hyatt.
- **Midscale or regional portfolio conversion:** BW Signature Collection, Trademark Collection, Handwritten Collection and **Series by Marriott**—the latter is designed to let regional hotel groups retain their existing identity while entering Marriott’s platform. ([hotel-development.marriott.com](https://www.hotel-development.marriott.com/brands/seriesbymarriott?utm_source=openai))
- **Resort, outdoor or conference-led asset:** Destination by Hyatt, Dolce Hotels and Resorts, Registry Collection or Marriott’s specialized Outdoor Collection.

The word **“soft” is relative**. Brand flexibility can differ materially regarding name retention, design standards, PIP requirements, F&B concepts, loyalty participation, operating systems, management versus franchise structure, territorial protection and required brand signage. Consequently, the right comparison is normally made at the **property-specific term-sheet and PIP level**, rather than from brand positioning alone.
